⍉Δ in proportions of HbA, HbA2, & HbF, just lower amounts
: in presence of ↓α chains, excess β chains are unstable & precipitate, causing damage to RBC
membranes which → intramedullary (bone marrow) & periph blood hemolysis
during periods of erythropoietic stress (ex, infect, preg)
: intrauterine ascites & hydrops fetalis, severe splenomegaly, ♡ & skeletal abnormalities
death in utero or shortly after birth
folic acid supp during periods of erythropoietic stress (ex, preg, acute infections)
: ↓β-globin chain synth results in a relative ⇡ in proportions of HbA2 & HbF compared to HbA as the β-like globins (δ & γ) substitute for the missing β chains
during periods of erythropoietic stress +/- Fe
infants protected by HbF up to 6mo of age
, after which HbF prod ⇣ & severe anemia develops
folic acid supp during periods of erythropoietic stress (ex, preg, acute infections)
